typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		RFCodeTag as string,
		CreationDate as timestamp,
		MaterialID as integer,
		SiteName as string,
		DuplicateLocationGroupName as string,
		WFGrid as string,
		RackNlyteID as integer,
		OperationalStatus as string,
		SiteGroup as string,
		AssetName as string,
		FirmwareVersion as string,
		MaterialType as string,
		DataHall as string,
		SerialNumber as string,
		NlyteID as integer,
		RackName as string,
		Manufacturer as string,
		Model as string,
		MaterialSubtype as string,
		MaterialName as string,
		RecordStatus as string,
		LastUpdateDate as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		RFCodeTag as string,
		CreationDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		MaterialID as integer,
		SiteName as string,
		DuplicateLocationGroupName as string,
		WFGrid as string,
		RackNlyteID as integer,
		OperationalStatus as string,
		SiteGroup as string,
		AssetName as string,
		FirmwareVersion as string,
		MaterialType as string,
		DataHall as string,
		SerialNumber as string,
		NlyteID as integer,
		RackName as string,
		Manufacturer as string,
		Model as string,
		MaterialSubtype as string,
		MaterialName as string,
		RecordStatus as string,
		LastUpdateDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		RFCodeTag,
		CreationDate,
		MaterialID,
		SiteName,
		DuplicateLocationGroupName,
		WFGrid,
		RackNlyteID,
		OperationalStatus,
		SiteGroup,
		AssetName,
		FirmwareVersion,
		MaterialType,
		DataHall,
		SerialNumber,
		NlyteID,
		RackName,
		Manufacturer,
		Model,
		MaterialSubtype,
		MaterialName,
		RecordStatus,
		LastUpdateDate),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
